description_en: Queries the details of one or more premium Internet bandwidth plans
description_zh: 查询一个或者多个公网精品带宽的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-network-packages --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --network-package-id np-amtp8e8q1o9e40000 --internet-charge-type PayByBandwidth --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNetworkPackages

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query.    

Maximum value: 100.    
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

最大值：100。    
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of premium Internet bandwidth plans. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 公网精品带宽ID。可设置1~100个
parameters.name: network_package_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the pay-as-you-go premium Internet bandwidth plan
parameters.help_zh: 按量付费公网精品带宽的计费方式
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. A maximum of 20 tags are supported
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
